+class Core:
+    """Inline-PTX emitter and model constants."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @dsl_user_op
+    def ptx(
+        code: str,
+        *ins,
+        outs: tuple = (),
+        volatile: bool = True,
+        memory: bool | None = None,
+        imm: bool = False,
+        loc=None,
+        ip=None,
+    ):
+        ins = [a if isinstance(a, cutlass.Numeric) else Int32(a) for a in ins]  # type: ignore[assignment]
+        values = [a.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for a in ins]
+        constraints = [f"={_constraint(t)}" for t in outs] + [
+            "n" if imm and _is_int_const(v) else _constraint(type(a))
+            for a, v in zip(ins, values)
+        ]
+        if volatile if memory is None else memory:
+            constraints.append("~{memory}")
+        if len(outs) == 0:
+            result_type = None
+        elif len(outs) == 1:
+            result_type = outs[0].mlir_type
+        else:
+            result_type = llvm.StructType.get_literal([t.mlir_type for t in outs])
+        joined = ",".join(constraints)
+        result = llvm.inline_asm(
+            result_type, values, code, joined, has_side_effects=volatile, loc=loc, ip=ip
+        )
+        if len(outs) == 0:
+            return None
+        if len(outs) == 1:
+            return outs[0](result)
+        return tuple(
+            t(llvm.extractvalue(t.mlir_type, result, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip))
+            for i, t in enumerate(outs)
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def pure(code: str, outs, *ins, imm: bool = False):
+        outs = outs if isinstance(outs, tuple) else (outs,)
+        return Core.ptx(code, *ins, outs=outs, volatile=False, imm=imm)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def vol(code: str, outs, *ins, imm: bool = False):
+        outs = outs if isinstance(outs, tuple) else (outs,)
+        return Core.ptx(code, *ins, outs=outs, memory=False, imm=imm)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def mem(code: str, outs, *ins):
+        return Core.ptx(code, *ins, outs=outs if isinstance(outs, tuple) else (outs,))
+
+    HIDDEN, VOCAB, SHARD_ROWS, RANKS = HIDDEN, VOCAB, SHARD_ROWS, RANKS
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @dsl_user_op
+    def asm(
+        code: str,
+        outs: str,
+        ins: str,
+        *args,
+        v: bool = False,
+        m: bool = False,
+        types=None,
+        loc=None,
+        ip=None,
+    ):
+        out_l = [c.strip() for c in outs.split(",") if c.strip()]
+        in_l = [c.strip() for c in ins.split(",") if c.strip()]
+        tied = [i for i, c in enumerate(out_l) if c.startswith("+")]
+        assert len(args) == len(tied) + len(in_l), (code, outs, ins, len(args))
+        ir_in = [_asm_operand(a, c, loc, ip) for a, c in zip(args[len(tied) :], in_l)]
+        ir_in += [
+            _asm_operand(a, out_l[i][1], loc, ip)
+            for a, i in zip(args[: len(tied)], tied)
+        ]
+        cons = ["=" + c[1] for c in out_l] + in_l + [str(i) for i in tied]
+        if m:
+            cons.append("~{memory}")
+        text = re.sub(r"%(\d+)", r"$\1", code.replace("$", "$$")).replace("%%", "%")
+        letters = [c[1] for c in out_l]
+        types = [_ASM_OUT[c] for c in letters] if types is None else types
+        if not out_l:
+            llvm.inline_asm(
+                None, ir_in, text, ",".join(cons), has_side_effects=v, loc=loc, ip=ip
+            )
+            return None
+        assert len(out_l) == 1, "asm with several outputs goes through Core.ptx"
+        out_type, joined = _ASM_IR[letters[0]](), ",".join(cons)
+        r = llvm.inline_asm(
+            out_type, ir_in, text, joined, has_side_effects=v, loc=loc, ip=ip
+        )
+        return types[0](r)

+_PTX_ROW = re.compile(
+    r"(\w+)\((.*)\)(?:\s*->\s*(\w+)(?:\*(\d+))?)?\s*\|\s*(\w+)(\+imm)?\s*\|\s*(.+)"
+)
+_PTX_TYPES = {
+    t.__name__: t for t in (Float32, Int16, Int32, Int64, Uint16, Uint32, Uint64)
+}

+
+def _ptx_helper(row: str):
+    name, params, out, count, mode, imm, code = _PTX_ROW.fullmatch(row.strip()).groups()
+    outs = () if out is None else (_PTX_TYPES[out],) * int(count or 1)
+    spec, sig = [], []
+    for p in filter(None, (p.strip() for p in params.split(","))):
+        pname, _, default = p.partition("=")
+        pname, _, ty = pname.partition(":")
+        width = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\w+)(?:\[(\d+)\])?", ty) if ty else None
+        if width:
+            spec.append(
+                (pname.strip(), _PTX_TYPES[width[1]], width[2] and int(width[2]))
+            )
+        kind = inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD
+        dflt = inspect.Parameter.empty if not default else default.strip() == "True"
+        sig.append(inspect.Parameter(pname.strip(), kind, default=dflt))
+    signature = inspect.Signature(sig)
+
+    def helper(*args, **kwargs):
+        bound = signature.bind(*args, **kwargs)
+        bound.apply_defaults()
+        memory = bound.arguments.get("memory", mode == "mem")
+        vals = [bound.arguments[pname] for pname, _, _ in spec]
+        if "%" in code:
+            outs_l = ",".join("=" + _constraint(t) for t in outs)
+            ins_l = ",".join(_constraint(t) for _, t, _ in spec)
+            types = list(outs) or None
+            return Core.asm(
+                code, outs_l, ins_l, *vals, v=mode != "pure", m=memory, types=types
+            )
+        ins = []
+        for v, (_, ty, n) in zip(vals, spec):
+            ins += [ty(x) for x in _seq(v, n)] if n else [ty(v)]
+        return Core.ptx(
+            code, *ins, outs=outs, volatile=mode != "pure", memory=memory, imm=bool(imm)
+        )
+
+    helper.__name__ = helper.__qualname__ = name
+    helper.__signature__ = signature  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    helper.__doc__ = f"``{code}``"
+    return name, helper
+
+
+def ptx_table(cls):
+    """Attach a static method for every row of ``cls.PTX``: ``name(param: Type, ...) ->
+    Out[*n] | mode | template``.
+    """
+    for row in filter(str.strip, cls.PTX.splitlines()):
+        name, helper = _ptx_helper(row)
+        setattr(cls, name, staticmethod(helper))
+    return cls

+    """``with WarpLeader(warp, n):`` runs its body in one elected lane of warp ``n``."""
+
+    __dsl_trace_time_ctxmgr__ = True
+
+    def __init__(self, warp, n: int) -> None:
+        self.warp, self.n = warp, n
+        self.regions: list[ir.InsertionPoint] = []
+
+    def _enter(self, cond) -> None:
+        if_op = scf.IfOp(cutlass.Boolean(cond).ir_value())
+        region = ir.InsertionPoint(if_op.then_block)
+        region.__enter__()
+        self.regions.append(region)
+
+    def __enter__(self) -> None:
+        self._enter(self.warp == self.n)
+        self._enter(Sync.elect_sync() != 0)
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_value, traceback) -> None:
+        while self.regions:
+            if exc_type is None:
+                scf.yield_([])
+            self.regions.pop().__exit__(exc_type, exc_value, traceback)

+class Prologue:
+    """Kernel prologue: thread ids, the dynamic shared-memory base, mbarrier init, role
+    entry.

+    def thread_ids():

+        lane = FastMath.cmod(tid, 32)
+        bid, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()

+        for off, n, arrivals in groups:
+            for i in range(n):
+                AsyncCopy.mbar_init(smem + off + 8 * i, arrivals)
+        if fence:

+    @staticmethod
+    def role_regs(increase: bool, count: int) -> None:
+        if increase:

+        else:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(count)

+    ``shape``.

+class SmemAlloc:
+    """Trace-time bump allocator of a kernel's dynamic shared memory."""
+
+    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
+        self.capacity = capacity
+        # Scopes: ["seq", cursor] or ["union", start, top].
+        self._frames: list[list] = [["seq", 0]]
+
+    @property
+    def cursor(self) -> int:
+        frame = self._frames[-1]
+        return frame[1] if frame[0] == "seq" else frame[2]
+
+    def alloc(self, nbytes: int, align: int = 16) -> int:
+        frame = self._frames[-1]
+        if frame[0] == "union":
+            assert frame[1] % align == 0, (frame[1], align)
+            frame[2] = max(frame[2], frame[1] + nbytes)
+            return frame[1]
+        off = -(-frame[1] // align) * align
+        frame[1] = off + nbytes
+        assert frame[1] <= self.capacity, (off, nbytes, self.capacity)
+        return off
+
+    def array(
+        self, dtype: type, shape, *, align: int | None = None, also: tuple = ()
+    ) -> Region:
+        shape = (shape,) if isinstance(shape, int) else tuple(shape)
+        region = Region(0, dtype, shape, tuple(also))
+        region.offset = self.alloc(region.nbytes, align or dtype.width // 8)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        return region
+
+    def mbarriers(self, n: int, arrivals: int | None = None) -> Region:
+        region = self.array(Uint64, n, align=8)
+        region.arrivals = arrivals
+        return region
+
+    def pad(self, nbytes: int) -> None:
+        self.alloc(nbytes, align=1)
+
+    @contextlib.contextmanager
+    def union(self, align: int = 16):
+        start = self.alloc(0, align)
+        self._frames.append(["union", start, start])
+        yield
+        top = self._frames.pop()[2]
+        self.alloc(top - start, align=1)
+
+    @contextlib.contextmanager
+    def arm(self):
+        union = self._frames[-1]
+        assert union[0] == "union", "arm() is only valid inside union()"
+        self._frames.append(["seq", union[1]])
+        yield
+        union[2] = max(union[2], self._frames.pop()[1])
+
+    def end(self) -> int:
+        assert len(self._frames) == 1 and self.cursor <= self.capacity, (
+            self.cursor,
+            self.capacity,
+        )
+        return self.cursor
+

+class SmemLayout(metaclass=Generated):
+    """A kernel's shared-memory map declared as a class body of :class:`SmemAlloc`
+    calls.
+    """
+
+    REGIONS: tuple = ()
+
+    def __init__(self, base) -> None:
+        self.base = base
+
+    def __init_subclass__(cls, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init_subclass__(**kwargs)
+        alloc = vars(cls).get("a")
+        if isinstance(alloc, SmemAlloc):
+            alloc.end()
+            cls.CAPACITY = alloc.capacity  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+            del cls.a
+        cls.REGIONS = (
+            tuple(r for r in vars(cls).values() if isinstance(r, Region)) or cls.REGIONS
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def barriers(cls) -> tuple:
+        return tuple(
+            (r.offset, r.size, r.arrivals)
+            for r in cls.REGIONS
+            if r.arrivals is not None
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def views(cls, order=()) -> tuple:
+        regions = sorted(
+            (r for r in cls.REGIONS if r.arrivals is None), key=lambda r: r.offset
+        )
+        rank = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(order)}
+        regions.sort(key=lambda r: rank.get(r.name, len(rank)))
+        return tuple(
+            (name, r.offset, dtype, n) for r in regions for name, dtype, n in r.views()
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def record(
+        cls, base, *, ring="", order=(), to_end=False, typed=False, bases=(), **extra
+    ):
+        values = {"base": base}
+        values.update(
+            (r.name, base + r.offset) for r in cls.REGIONS if r.arrivals is not None
+        )
+        if ring:
+            values[ring] = Pipeline.Ring(
+                values["ring_full"], values["ring_empty"], cls.ring_full.size
+            )
+        table = cls.views(order)
+        if to_end:
+            table = tuple(
+                (n, off, t, (cls.CAPACITY - off) * 8 // t.width)
+                for n, off, t, _ in table
+            )
+        views = Memory.smem_views(base, table)
+        for name, _, dtype, _ in table:
+            values[name] = Memory.typed(views[name], dtype) if typed else views[name]
+        values.update((name + "_addr", views[name + "_addr"]) for name, *_ in table)
+        values.update(extra)
+        fields = [(name, object, field(default=None)) for name in values]
+        return make_dataclass(
+            cls.__name__ + "Record", fields, bases=bases, frozen=True
+        )(**values)

+class Params:
+    """Mixin for a params record: pointers as typed views or addresses; peer bases."""

+    EXTENT = 1 << 30
+    UNSIGNED: dict = {}
+    READ_ONLY: dict = {}

+class DecodeKernel(ABC):
+    """One served decode kernel built from a params record and a fixed skeleton."""
+
+    Params: type
+    GRID: int
+    BLOCK: int = 384
+    SMEM_BYTES: int = 0
+    #: ``.minnctapersm`` (required with ``setmaxnreg``); None leaves it out.
+    MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP: int | None = 1
+    #: Emit ``.maxntid`` (``max_number_threads``) as well as ``.reqntid``.
+    MAX_THREADS: bool = False
+    USE_PDL: bool = True
+    #: Host-wrapper arguments after the params record fields: ``(name, DSL type)``.
+    HOST_ARGS: tuple = ()
+
+    def __init__(self, **constants: int | bool) -> None:
+        for name, value in constants.items():
+            if not hasattr(type(self), name):
+                raise TypeError(
+                    f"{type(self).__name__} has no compile-time knob {name}"
+                )
+            setattr(self, name, value)
+
+    def smem(self, base: Int32):
+        return None
+
+    def mbarriers(self) -> tuple:
+        return ()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def prologue(self, p):
+        tid, bid, warp, lane = Prologue.thread_ids()
+        _, base = Prologue.smem()
+        s = self.smem(base)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(len(self.mbarriers()) > 0):
+            with WarpLeader(warp, 0):
+                Prologue.init_mbarriers(base, self.mbarriers())
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        return ThreadIds(tid, bid, warp, lane), s
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(self, p, s, ids: ThreadIds) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def epoch_ticket(self, warp: Int32, full_epoch, slot) -> None:
+        with WarpLeader(warp, 9):
+            ticket = cute.arch.atomic_add(full_epoch, Uint32(1))
+            slot[0] = FastMath.cdiv(ticket, Uint32(self.GRID))
+
+    def tensor_maps(self, p) -> tuple:
+        return ()
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, p):
+        ids, s = self.prologue(p)
+        self.run(p, s, ids)
+
+    def _launch_bounds(self) -> dict:
+        bounds = {}
+        if self.SMEM_BYTES:
+            bounds["smem"] = self.SMEM_BYTES
+        if self.MAX_THREADS:
+            bounds["max_number_threads"] = [self.BLOCK, 1, 1]  # type: ignore[assignment]
+        if self.MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP is not None:
+            bounds["min_blocks_per_mp"] = self.MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP
+        return bounds
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def launch(self, *args):
+        *buffers, stream = args
+        p = self.Params(*buffers)
+        kernel = self.kernel(p, *self.tensor_maps(p))
+        grid, block, bounds = (
+            (self.GRID, 1, 1),
+            (self.BLOCK, 1, 1),
+            self._launch_bounds(),
+        )
+        kernel.launch(
+            grid=grid, block=block, stream=stream, use_pdl=self.USE_PDL, **bounds
+        )
+

+class RoleKernel(DecodeKernel):
+    """A warp-specialized kernel: :meth:`run` hands each warp range of ``ROLES`` to its
+    role method.
+    """
+
+    ROLES: tuple[Role, ...]
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def run(self, p, s, ids: ThreadIds) -> None:
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(self.ROLES)):
+            role = self.ROLES[i]
+            if cutlass.const_expr(role.first == 0):
+                if ids.warp <= role.last:
+                    getattr(self, role.method)(p, s, ids)
+            else:
+                if (ids.warp >= role.first) & (ids.warp <= role.last):
+                    getattr(self, role.method)(p, s, ids)
+
+    def set_regs(self, method: str) -> None:
+        role = next(r for r in self.ROLES if r.method == method)
+        Prologue.role_regs(role.increase, role.regs)
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def compute(self, p, s, ids: ThreadIds) -> Int32 | None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def load(self, p, s, ids: ThreadIds) -> None:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+

+        self.up_map, self.down_map = UpMap.get_ptr().toint(), DownMap.get_ptr().toint()
+        ids, s = self.prologue(p)
+        self.run(p, s, ids)

+class TaggedMailbox:
+    """TP8 tagged mailboxes (flag-in-data exchange): 24-bit payload words tagged with
+    the launch's generation.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def tag8(epoch) -> Uint32:
+        return Uint32(128) | ((epoch + 1) & 127)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def pack24(w, tag_high) -> tuple:
+        return (
+            (w[0] & 16777215) | tag_high,
+            (w[0] >> 24) | ((w[1] & 65535) << 8) | tag_high,
+            (w[1] >> 16) | ((w[2] & 255) << 16) | tag_high,
+            (w[2] >> 8) | tag_high,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def unpack24(v) -> tuple:
+        return (
+            (v[0] & 16777215) | (v[1] << 24),
+            ((v[1] >> 8) & 65535) | (v[2] << 16),
+            ((v[2] >> 16) & 255) | (v[3] << 8),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def peer_base(index, bases) -> Int64:
+        return Memory.select_peer(index, bases)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def push(address, words) -> None:
+        Memory.st_volatile_v4(address, words)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def stale(words, tag) -> Uint32:
+        bits = Uint32(0)
+        for w in _list(words):
+            bits = bits | ((w >> 24) ^ tag)
+        return bits
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def poll(packets: cute.Tensor, addresses, tag):
+        addresses = _list(addresses)
+        fresh = Uint32(1)
+        while fresh != 0:
+            for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(addresses)):
+                (
+                    packets[4 * p],
+                    packets[4 * p + 1],
+                    packets[4 * p + 2],
+                    packets[4 * p + 3],
+                ) = Memory.ld_volatile_v4(addresses[p])
+            fresh = Uint32(0)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4 * len(addresses)):
+                fresh = fresh | ((packets[i] >> 24) ^ tag)
+

+class Pipeline:
+    """mbarrier page rings: a producer warp streams pages into shared-memory slots for
+    consumers.
+    """
+
+    class Ring:
+        """One ring: ``slots`` full/empty mbarrier pairs, 8 bytes apart, at 32-bit
+        shared addresses.
+        """
+
+        def __init__(self, full_addr, empty_addr, slots: int):
+            self.full_addr, self.empty_addr, self.slots = full_addr, empty_addr, slots
+
+        def __extract_mlir_values__(self):
+            return [
+                v
+                for a in (self.full_addr, self.empty_addr)
+                for v in Int32(a).__extract_mlir_values__()
+            ]
+
+        def __new_from_mlir_values__(self, values):
+            return Pipeline.Ring(Int32(values[0]), Int32(values[1]), self.slots)
+
+        def slot(self, sequence):
+            return FastMath.cmod(sequence, self.slots)
+
+        def parity(self, sequence):
+            return FastMath.cmod(FastMath.cdiv(sequence, self.slots), 2)
+
+        def full(self, slot):
+            return self.full_addr + slot * 8
+
+        def empty(self, slot):
+            return self.empty_addr + slot * 8
+
+        def wait_full(self, sequence, slot=None) -> None:
+            AsyncCopy.mbar_wait(
+                self.full(self.slot(sequence) if slot is None else slot),
+                self.parity(sequence),
+            )
+
+        def release(self, slot) -> None:
+            Memory.fence_proxy_async_shared()
+            AsyncCopy.mbar_arrive(self.empty(slot))
+
+        def acquire(self, sequence, nbytes: int, slot=None) -> None:
+            slot = self.slot(sequence) if slot is None else slot
+            AsyncCopy.mbar_wait(self.empty(slot), self.parity(sequence) ^ 1)
+            AsyncCopy.mbar_expect_tx(self.full(slot), nbytes)
+

+class Scan:
+    """Warp and CTA scans over the 8 compute warps."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def up(v, lane):
+        for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+            carried = Sync.shfl_up(v, 1 << s)
+            if lane >= (1 << s):
+                v = v + carried
+        return v
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def cta(value, warp_eq, warp, lane):
+        inclusive = Scan.up(value, lane)
+        Scan.last_lane(warp_eq, warp, lane, inclusive)
+        Sync.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        before, total = Scan.block_prefix(warp_eq, warp, Int32(0))
+        Sync.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        return inclusive, before, total
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def last_lane(arr, warp, lane, value):
+        if lane == 31:
+            arr[warp] = value
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def block_prefix(arr, warp, init):
+        before = init
+        total = Int32(0)
+        for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            c = arr[w]
+            if warp > w:
+                before = before + c
+            total = total + c
+        return before, total
+

+class Reduce:
+    """Reductions and RMSNorm in a fixed association order, with ``.ftz`` float math."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def sum_squares(values, start=None) -> Float32:
+        acc = Float32(0.0) if start is None else start
+        for v in _list(values):
+            acc = FastMath.fma(v, v, acc)
+        return acc
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def warp_sum_down(x, steps: int = 5) -> Float32:
+        for step in range(steps):
+            x = FastMath.add(x, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_down(x, 16 >> step))
+        return x
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def ordered_sum(read, n: int, first: int = 0) -> Float32:
+        total = read(first)
+        for i in range(first + 1, first + n):
+            total = FastMath.add(total, read(i))
+        return total
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def strided_sum(t, idx, stride: int, n: int = 8) -> Float32:
+        total = t[idx]
+        for w in range(1, n):
+            total = FastMath.add(total, t[w * stride + idx])
+        return total
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def rms_inverse(total, n: float = 6144.0, eps: float = 1e-05) -> Float32:
+        return FastMath.rsqrt(FastMath.add(FastMath.div_rn(total, n), eps))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def norm_bf16x8(values, inverse, gamma) -> list:
+        y = [FastMath.mul(FastMath.mul(values[i], inverse), gamma[i]) for i in range(8)]
+        return [Convert.f32x2_to_bf16x2(y[2 * i], y[2 * i + 1]) for i in range(4)]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def fold(vals, lane, bit, tail: cutlass.Constexpr):
+        vals = _list(vals)
+        for _ in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(vals).bit_length() - 1):
+            half = len(vals) // 2
+            out = []
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(half):
+                kept = vals[i]
+                sent = vals[half + i]
+                if (lane & bit) != 0:
+                    kept = vals[half + i]
+                    sent = vals[i]
+                out.append(FastMath.add(kept, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(sent, bit)))
+            vals = out
+            bit = bit >> 1
+        last = vals[0]
+        for b in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(tail)):
+            last = FastMath.add(last, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(last, tail[b]))
+        return last
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def argmax_better(ov, oi, v, i):
+        return FastMath.fcmp(">", ov, v) | (FastMath.fcmp("==", ov, v) & (oi < i))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def argmax_bfly(v: Float32, i: Int32, offsets: cutlass.Constexpr):
+        for off in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(offsets)):
+            ov = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(v, offsets[off])
+            oi = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(i, offsets[off])
+            if Reduce.argmax_better(ov, oi, v, i):
+                v = ov
+                i = oi
+        return v, i
+

+class Mma:
+    """FP8 (E4M3) weight-page MMA steps of the GEMV families."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def gate_up_steps(accum, rows, b_word, gate_scale, up_scale, tiles=None) -> None:
+        count = tiles or 1
+        page_acc = cute.make_rmem_tensor(8 * count, Float32)
+        for k in range(8):
+            b = b_word(k)
+            for half in range(2):
+                frag = Convert.a_frag_u32(rows[16 * half + k], rows[16 * half + 8 + k])
+                for t in range(count):
+                    acc_tile = cute.local_tile(page_acc, (4,), (2 * t + half,))
+                    TensorCore.mma_acc(acc_tile, frag, b[t] if tiles else b, k == 0)
+        for t in range(count):
+            for i in range(4):
+                accum[8 * t + i] = FastMath.fma(
+                    page_acc[8 * t + i], gate_scale, accum[8 * t + i]
+                )
+                accum[8 * t + 4 + i] = FastMath.fma(
+                    page_acc[8 * t + 4 + i], up_scale, accum[8 * t + 4 + i]
+                )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def step_u64(acc, row_a, row_b, k_half: int, b, zero: bool) -> list:
+        return TensorCore.mma(acc, Convert.a_frag_u64(row_a, row_b, k_half), b, zero)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def scale_accumulate(total, partial, scale) -> list:
+        partial = _list(partial)
+        return [FastMath.fma(partial[i], scale, total[i]) for i in range(len(partial))]

+class SliceExchange:
+    """TP8 all-reduce of each CTA's 48-column output slice of ``rows`` token rows (MoE,
+    dense FFN).
+    """
+
+    COLUMNS, TOKEN, CHUNK = 48, 128, 16
+    #: Tokens one warp carries (lanes / 8 packets per token).
+    GROUP_TOKENS = 4
+
+    def __init__(self, rows: int, seam: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.rows, self.seam = rows, seam
+        #: Token groups, and 8-row MMA tiles, of the capacity.
+        self.groups = -(-rows // SliceExchange.GROUP_TOKENS)
+        self.tiles = max(1, -(-rows // 8))
+        self.SLICE = SliceExchange.TOKEN * rows
+        self.PARITY = 128 * self.SLICE
+        self.SLOT = 2 * self.PARITY
+        self.OWN = 7 * self.SLOT
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def reduce_rows(self, scratch, local_o, LocalO, total, tid, warp, lane, bid):
+        rows, columns = self.rows, SliceExchange.COLUMNS
+        stride = columns * rows + 1
+        if cmod(lane, 4) < max(1, min(4, rows // 2)):
+            base = warp * stride + cdiv(lane, 4)
+            token = cmod(lane, 4) * 2
+            if cutlass.const_expr(rows <= 4):
+                token = cmod(token, 4)
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.tiles):
+                for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                    for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, 4, 1 if rows >= 4 else 2):
+                        column = token + 1 if e % 2 else token
+                        column = column + 8 * t if t else column
+                        scratch[base + column * columns + m * 16 + 8 * (e // 2)] = (
+                            total[t * 12 + m * 4 + e]
+                        )
+        bar_sync(8, 256)
+        # 256 threads sum 48 x rows outputs: one round up to five rows, more above.
+        for index_round in cutlass.range_constexpr(-(-columns * rows // 256)):
+            index = tid + 256 * index_round if index_round else tid
+            if index < columns * rows:
+                value = Reduce.strided_sum(scratch, index, stride)
+                local_o[index] = value.to(BFloat16)
+                LocalO[
+                    cdiv(index, columns) * HIDDEN + bid * columns + cmod(index, columns)
+                ] = value.to(BFloat16)
+        bar_sync(8, 256)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def push(self, words, epoch, slice_, lane, base, slot_offset, group: int = 0):
+        token = cdiv(lane, 8)
+        if group:
+            token = token + SliceExchange.GROUP_TOKENS * group
+        chunk = cmod(lane, 8)
+        tag_high = (128 | epoch + 1 & 127) << 24
+        w = [Uint32(words[token * 24 + chunk * 3 + i]) for i in range(3)]
+        Memory.st_volatile_v4(
+            base
+            + Int64(
+                slot_offset
+                + Int32(cmod(epoch, 2)) * self.PARITY
+                + slice_ * self.SLICE
+                + token * SliceExchange.TOKEN
+                + chunk * SliceExchange.CHUNK
+            ),
+            TaggedMailbox.pack24(w, tag_high),
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def push_peers(self, p, words, epoch, slice_, tid, warp, lane):
+        pushing = tid < 224
+        if pushing:
+            destination = cutlass.select_(warp < p.peer_rank, warp, warp + 1)
+            source_slot = cutlass.select_(
+                destination > p.peer_rank, p.peer_rank, p.peer_rank - 1
+            )
+            peer = Memory.select_peer(destination, p.peer_bases)
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.groups):
+                self.push(
+                    words, epoch, slice_, lane, peer, source_slot * self.SLOT, group
+                )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def combine(
+        self,
+        p,
+        src,
+        lane,
+        slice_,
+        epoch,
+        own_words=None,
+        own_wait: cutlass.Constexpr = False,
+        group=0,
+        live=None,
+    ):
+        seam, columns = self.seam, SliceExchange.COLUMNS
+        peer_rank = p.peer_rank
+        slots = 8 if seam else 7
+        token = cdiv(lane, 8)
+        # ``group`` is a trace-time int (0: the first four tokens) or a per-warp value.
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not isinstance(group, int) or group != 0):
+            token = token + SliceExchange.GROUP_TOKENS * group
+        chunk = cmod(lane, 8)
+        active = Int32(token < live) if live is not None else None
+        row = token * HIDDEN + slice_ * columns + chunk * 6
+        residual = [src[row + item].to(Float32) for item in range(6)]
+        gamma = None
+        own = None
+        if cutlass.const_expr(seam):
+            gamma = [
+                p.GammaNext[slice_ * columns + chunk * 6 + item] for item in range(6)
+            ]
+        else:
+            own = [Uint32(own_words[token * 24 + chunk * 3 + i]) for i in range(3)]
+        mailbox = Memory.select_peer(peer_rank, p.peer_bases)
+        tag8 = 128 | epoch + 1 & 127
+        first = (
+            Int32(cmod(epoch, 2)) * self.PARITY
+            + slice_ * self.SLICE
+            + token * SliceExchange.TOKEN
+            + chunk * SliceExchange.CHUNK
+        )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(own_wait):
+            own_waiting = Int32(1)
+            while own_waiting != 0:
+                v = Memory.ld_volatile_v4(mailbox + Int64(first + self.OWN))
+                own_stale = TaggedMailbox.stale([v[k] for k in range(4)], tag8)
+                if cute.arch.vote_all_sync(own_stale == 0):
+                    own_waiting = Int32(0)
+                else:
+                    backoff = globaltimer()
+                    spinning = Int32(1)
+                    while spinning != 0:
+                        if globaltimer() - backoff >= 1000:
+                            spinning = Int32(0)
+        incoming = cute.make_rmem_tensor(3 * slots, Uint32)
+        ld = cute.make_rmem_tensor(4 * slots, Uint32)
+        polling = Int32(1)
+        while polling != 0:
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+                v = Memory.ld_volatile_v4(mailbox + Int64(first + self.SLOT * j))
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    ld[4 * j + k] = v[k]
+            stale = TaggedMailbox.stale([ld[i] for i in range(4 * slots)], tag8)
+            fresh = stale == 0
+            if cutlass.const_expr(live is not None):
+                fresh = (stale == 0) | (active == 0)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(seam):
+                fresh = cute.arch.vote_all_sync(fresh)
+            if fresh:
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(slots):
+                    for i, word in enumerate(
+                        TaggedMailbox.unpack24([ld[4 * j + k] for k in range(4)])
+                    ):
+                        incoming[3 * j + i] = word
+                polling = Int32(0)
+        sums = [Float32(0.0)] * 6
+        words = cute.make_rmem_tensor(3, Uint32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(seam):
+            own = [incoming[21 + i] for i in range(3)]
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            if r == peer_rank:
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                    words[i] = own[i]  # type: ignore[index]
+            elif peer_rank > r:
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                    words[i] = incoming[min(3 * r, 18) + i]
+            else:
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                    words[i] = incoming[max(3 * r - 3, 0) + i]
+            vals = bf16x8_to_f32([words[i] for i in range(3)])
+            sums = [add(sums[i], vals[i]) for i in range(6)]
+        reduced = bf16x8_to_f32(
+            [f32x2_to_bf16x2(sums[2 * i], sums[2 * i + 1]) for i in range(3)]
+        )
+        for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(6):
+            x = add(reduced[item], residual[item]).to(BFloat16)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(live is None):  # noqa: SIM114  constexpr and runtime conditions stay separate
+                p.Final[row + item] = x
+                if cutlass.const_expr(seam):
+                    p.XG[row + item] = mul(x.to(Float32), gamma[item]).to(BFloat16)  # type: ignore[index]
+            elif active != 0:
+                p.Final[row + item] = x
+                if cutlass.const_expr(seam):
+                    p.XG[row + item] = mul(x.to(Float32), gamma[item]).to(BFloat16)  # type: ignore[index]
+

+class OExchange:
+    """TP8 O exchange of a CTA's 48-column slice of up to four rows (MLA worker, MTP
+    preprocess).
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def word(token, source, parity, slot, packet):
+        return token * 57344 + source * 8192 + parity * 4096 + slot * 32 + packet * 4
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def push(
+        local_o_words, bases, peer_rank, epoch, token, packed_peer, chunk, slot
+    ) -> None:
+        destination = FastMath.select_i32(
+            packed_peer < peer_rank, packed_peer, packed_peer + 1
+        )
+        source_slot = FastMath.select_i32(
+            destination > peer_rank, peer_rank, peer_rank - 1
+        )
+        payload = [local_o_words[token * 24 + chunk * 3 + i] for i in range(3)]
+        words = TaggedMailbox.pack24(payload, TaggedMailbox.tag8(epoch) << 24)
+        first = OExchange.word(token, source_slot, cmod(epoch + 1, 2), slot, chunk)
+        TaggedMailbox.push(
+            TaggedMailbox.peer_base(destination, bases) + Int64(first * 4), words
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def reduce(
+        local_o_words, local_o_addr, peer_rank, query_, lane, received: int = 128
+    ) -> None:
+        sums = [Float32(0.0)] * 4
+        loaded = []
+        for r in range(8):
+            own = Int32(peer_rank == r)
+            above = Int32(peer_rank < r)
+            peer_word = received + query_ * 168 + (r - above) * 24 + lane * 2
+            word = own * (query_ * 24 + lane * 2) + (1 - own) * peer_word
+            loaded.append((local_o_words[word], local_o_words[word + 1]))
+        for r in range(8):
+            f = list(Convert.bf16x2_to_f32x2(loaded[r][0])) + list(
+                Convert.bf16x2_to_f32x2(loaded[r][1])
+            )
+            sums = [add(sums[i], f[i]) for i in range(4)]
+        out_at = local_o_addr + (query_ * 24 + lane * 2) * 4
+        Memory.st_shared_v2(
+            out_at, f32x2_to_bf16x2(sums[0], sums[1]), f32x2_to_bf16x2(sums[2], sums[3])
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    @cute.jit
+    def receive(
+        received_words, base, parity, tag, slot, lane_0, items, n: cutlass.Constexpr
+    ):
+        incoming = rmem_tensor(3 * len(items), Uint32)
+        done = Int32(0)
+        while done == 0:
+            vs = [
+                Memory.ld_volatile_v4(
+                    base
+                    + Int64(
+                        cdiv(it, 56) * 57344
+                        + cmod(cdiv(it, 8), 7) * 8192
+                        + parity * 4096
+                        + slot * 32
+                        + cmod(it, 8) * 4
+                    )
+                    * 4
+                )
+                for it in items
+            ]
+            stale = Uint32(0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4 * len(items)):
+                stale = stale | ((vs[w // 4][w % 4] >> 24) ^ tag)
+            if stale == 0:
+                for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(items)):
+                    vh = vs[h]
+                    incoming[3 * h] = (vh[0] & 16777215) | (vh[1] << 24)
+                    incoming[3 * h + 1] = ((vh[1] >> 8) & 65535) | (vh[2] << 16)
+                    incoming[3 * h + 2] = ((vh[2] >> 16) & 255) | (vh[3] << 8)
+                done = Int32(1)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(len(items) > 1):
+            syncwarp()
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(items)):
+            it = lane_0 + 128 * k
+            if it < n:
+                word = cdiv(it, 8) * 24 + cmod(it, 8) * 3
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                    received_words[word + i] = incoming[3 * k + i]

+class Poll:
+    """Spin-polls of generation-tagged u64 mailbox records: the tag is the hi 32 bits,
+    or (``tag40``) bits 40..
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def tagged(word, want, tag40: bool) -> Int32:
+        if tag40:
+            return Int32(Uint32(word >> 40) == (want & Uint32(16777215)))
+        return Int32(Uint32(word >> 32) == want)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def bin_record(generation, pair):
+        return (

+                running = before + inclusive - own
+                found = Int32(0)
+                for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    running = running + counts[item]
+                    if (found == 0) & (running >= need):

+                        control[1] = running - counts[item]
+                        control[2] = counts[item]
+                        found = Int32(1)
+            bar_sync(8, 256)

+            lean_above = control[1]
+            ties = control[2]
+            bar_sync(8, 256)

+        blocks,
+        blocks_addr,
+        bits,

+        warps,

+        key,
+        need,
+        tid,

+        bar_sync(8, 256)

+            end = begin + span

+    """

+
+    @staticmethod
+    def instruction_descriptor(n: int) -> int:
+        assert n % 16 == 0 and 16 <= n <= 256, n
+        return 16 | ((n >> 3) << 17) | (8 << 24)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def operand_low(smem_addr):
+        return (smem_addr >> 4) & 0x3FFF
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def mma_k128(a_low, b_low, tmem, n: int, accumulate) -> None:
+        step = (
+            "add.u32 a_lo, a_lo, 2; add.u32 b_lo, b_lo, 2; mov.b64 da, {a_lo, adhi}; "
+            "mov.b64 db, {b_lo, bdhi};"
+            " tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::f8f6f4 [$2], da, db, id, p1; "
+        )
+        code = (
+            "{ .reg .pred p0, p1; .reg .b32 adhi, bdhi, a_lo, b_lo, id;"
+            " .reg .b64 da, db;"
+            " setp.ne.b32 p0, $3, 0; setp.ne.b32 p1, 1, 0; "
+            f"mov.b32 adhi, {Umma.DESCRIPTOR_HIGH:#x};"
+            f" mov.b32 bdhi, {Umma.DESCRIPTOR_HIGH:#x};"
+            f" mov.b32 id, {Umma.instruction_descriptor(n)};"
+            " mov.b32 a_lo, $0; mov.b32 b_lo, $1;"
+            " mov.b64 da, {a_lo, adhi}; mov.b64 db, {b_lo, bdhi};"
+            " tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::f8f6f4 [$2], da, db, id, p0; "
+            + step * 3
+            + "}"
+        )
+        Core.vol(
+            code,
+            (),
+            Int32(a_low),
+            Int32(b_low),
+            Int32(tmem),
+            Int32(accumulate),
+            imm=True,
+        )

+        assert count in (8, 16, 32, 64), count

+        a.mbarriers(RING_SLOTS, arrivals=1),
+        a.mbarriers(RING_SLOTS, arrivals=COMPUTE_THREADS),
+        a.array(Float32, scratch_words, align=1024),
+        a.array(Uint32, 1),
+        a.array(Float32, (2, INTERMEDIATE // BLOCK), align=16),
+        a.array(BFloat16, (rows, DownWeights.ROWS), align=512, also=(Uint32,)),
+        a.array(Uint8, (RING_SLOTS, SLOT_BYTES), align=1024),
+    )
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def rows_smem(rows: int) -> type:
+    """Return the shared-memory layout class of the streaming build of ``rows`` rows."""
+    size = rt.SmemAlloc(1 << 30)
+    _rows_regions(size, rows)
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class DenseRowsSmem(RingSmem, rt.SmemLayout):
+        base: Int32
+        a = rt.SmemAlloc(size.cursor)
+        (
+            ring_full,
+            ring_empty,
+            scratch,
+            epoch,
+            down_scales,
+            local_o,
+            ring,
+        ) = _rows_regions(a, rows)
+
+    return DenseRowsSmem
+
+
+class DenseFfn(rt.UpDownMapKernel):
+    """128 CTAs x 384 threads: compute warps 0-7, loader warps 8-11."""
+
+    Params = DenseFfnParams
+    GRID = GRID
+    BLOCK = THREADS
+    MAX_THREADS = True
+    ROWS = TOKENS
+    ROLES = (
+        rt.Role("compute", 0, COMPUTE_WARPS - 1, regs=216, increase=True),
+        rt.Role("load", COMPUTE_WARPS, THREADS // 32 - 1, regs=72, increase=False),
+    )
+
+    @property
+    def STREAM(self) -> bool:
+        return self.ROWS > TOKENS
+
+    @property
+    def XN_OFFSET(self) -> int:
+        return (INTERMEDIATE // Activations.GROUP_COLS) * self.ROWS * 2 * 256
+
+    @property
+    def SLICES(self) -> rt.SliceExchange:
+        return rt.SliceExchange(self.ROWS)
+
+    @property
+    def layout(self) -> type:
+        return rows_smem(self.ROWS) if self.STREAM else DenseFfnSmem
+
+    @property
+    def SMEM_BYTES(self) -> int:  # type: ignore[override]
+        return self.layout.CAPACITY if self.STREAM else SMEM_BYTES  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+    def smem(self, base):
+        return self.layout(base)
+
+    def mbarriers(self) -> tuple:
+        return self.layout.barriers()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
+    def tensor_maps(self, p) -> tuple:
+        up_box, down_box = (
+            [BLOCK, UpWeights.ROWS, UpWeights.PAGE_SLICES],
+            [BLOCK, DownWeights.ROWS, 1],
+        )
+        down = p.DenseDown.toint()
+        return (
+            rt.byte_map(
+                p.DenseUp.toint(),
+                [BLOCK, 2 * INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN // BLOCK],
+                [HIDDEN, BLOCK],
+                up_box,
+                True,
+                True,
+            ),
+            rt.byte_map(
+                down,
+                [INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN, 1],
+                [INTERMEDIATE, HIDDEN * INTERMEDIATE],
+                down_box,
+                True,
+                True,
+            ),
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def compute(self, p, s, ids):
+        tid, bid, warp, lane = ids.tid, ids.bid, ids.warp, ids.lane
+        self.set_regs("compute")
+        views, p = p.views(), p.addresses()
+        pages = s.pages()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.STREAM):
+            self.compute_rows(tid, bid, warp, lane, views, p, s, pages)
+        else:
+            gamma = [
+                rt.bf16x8_to_f32(
+                    rt.Memory.ldg_nc_v4(
+                        p.Gamma + s.NORM_CHUNK_BYTES * j + Int64(tid) * 16
+                    )
+                )
+                for j in range(s.NORM_CHUNKS)
+            ]
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            if bid < UpWeights.CTAS:
+                rt.mbar_wait(s.x_full, 0)
+                self.rmsnorm(tid, warp, lane, s, gamma)
+            rt.bar_sync(*BAR_ALL)
+            epoch = rt.Memory.lds(s.epoch, Uint32)
+            first_down = Int32(0)
+            if bid < UpWeights.CTAS:
+                self.gate_up(tid, warp, lane, bid, p, s, pages)
+                first_down = Int32(UpWeights.PAGES)
+            total = self.down(warp, lane, bid, s, pages, first_down)
+            self.exchange(tid, warp, lane, bid, views, s, epoch, total)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def rmsnorm(self, tid, warp, lane, s, gamma):
+        for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(TOKENS):
+            row = s.xn + s.X_ROW_BYTES * token + tid * 16
+            values = []
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(s.NORM_CHUNKS):
+                values += rt.bf16x8_to_f32(
+                    rt.Memory.lds_v4(row + s.NORM_CHUNK_BYTES * j)
+                )
+            square = rt.Reduce.warp_sum_down(rt.Reduce.sum_squares(values))
+            if lane == 0:
+                rt.Memory.sts(s.scratch + 4 * warp, square)
+            rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+            inverse = rt.Reduce.rms_inverse(
+                rt.Reduce.ordered_sum(
+                    lambda w: rt.Memory.lds(s.scratch + 4 * w), COMPUTE_WARPS
+                )
+            )
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(s.NORM_CHUNKS):
+                rt.Memory.sts_v4(
+                    row + s.NORM_CHUNK_BYTES * j,
+                    rt.Reduce.norm_bf16x8(
+                        values[s.NORM_VEC * j : s.NORM_VEC * j + s.NORM_VEC],
+                        inverse,
+                        gamma[j],
+                    ),
+                )
+            rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def gate_up(self, tid, warp, lane, bid, p, s, pages):
+        ring = s.ring
+        accum = [Float32(0.0)] * 8
+        q = lane & 3
+        chunks = UpWeights.chunk_pair(q)
+        group = lane >> 2
+        x_words = [s.x_word(lane >> 3, c) for c in chunks]
+        for page in cutlass.range_constexpr(UpWeights.PAGES):
+            slot = page % s.RING_SLOTS
+            pages.wait_full(page)
+            base = s.slot_base(ring, slot)
+            lane_chunks = [UpWeights.chunk(base, warp, group, c) for c in chunks]
+            a_words = [None] * 32
+            for proj in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for hi in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        k = 16 * proj + 8 * hi + 4 * c
+                        a_words[k : k + 4] = rt.Memory.lds_b128(
+                            ring
+                            + lane_chunks[c]
+                            + 8 * SWIZZLE_ROW * hi
+                            + UpWeights.BOX_BYTES * proj
+                        )
+            slot_scales = ring + base + UpWeights.SLOT_SCALES
+            scales = [
+                rt.Memory.lds(slot_scales + UpWeights.SCALE_BYTES * proj + 4 * warp)
+                for proj in range(2)
+            ]
+            k_words = page * (UpWeights.PAGE_K // 2) + warp * (UpWeights.SLICE_K // 2)
+            b_words = lambda k, k_words=k_words: rt.Memory.lds_weak_b64(
+                s.xn + 4 * (x_words[k // 4] + k_words + 2 * (k % 4))
+            )
+            rt.Mma.gate_up_steps(accum, a_words, b_words, *scales)
+            pages.release(slot)
+        store = s.scratch + 4 * s.up_partial_word(warp, q, 0, group)
+        for proj in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            for hi in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                word = s.up_partial_word(0, 0, proj, 8 * hi)
+                rt.Memory.sts(store + 4 * word, accum[4 * proj + 2 * hi])
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+        if tid < TOKENS * UpWeights.ROWS:
+            token, n = tid >> UpWeights.ROW_SHIFT, tid & (UpWeights.ROWS - 1)
+            gate, up = [
+                rt.Convert.bf16_to_f32(
+                    rt.Convert.f32_to_bf16(
+                        rt.Reduce.ordered_sum(
+                            lambda w, proj=proj: rt.Memory.lds(
+                                s.scratch + 4 * s.up_partial_word(w, token, proj, n)
+                            ),
+                            COMPUTE_WARPS,
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+                for proj in (0, 1)
+            ]
+            e = cute.math.exp2(rt.mul(gate, NEG_LOG2E), fastmath=True)
+            rcp = rt.FastMath.rcp_rn(rt.add(1.0, e))
+            col = Activations.col(
+                (bid & (Activations.GROUP_CTAS - 1)) * UpWeights.ROWS + n
+            )
+            index = Activations.index(bid >> Activations.GROUP_SHIFT, token, col)
+            dst = p.Activation + Int64(index) * 2
+            rt.Memory.stg_b16(
+                dst, rt.Convert.f32_to_bf16(rt.mul(rt.mul(gate, rcp), up))
+            )
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+        with rt.warp_leader(warp, 0):
+            rt.Memory.fence_release_gpu()
+            rt.Memory.red_add_u32(p.Flags + Int64(bid) * 4, 1)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def down(self, warp, lane, bid, s, pages, first_down):
+        ring = s.ring
+        total = [Float32(0.0)] * (4 * DownWeights.TILES)
+        lane_word = DownWeights.lane_word(warp, lane)
+        act_word = Activations.b_word(warp, lane)
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_ALL)
+        for page in cutlass.range_constexpr(DownWeights.PAGES):
+            sequence = first_down + page
+            slot = pages.slot(sequence)
+            pages.wait_full(sequence, slot)
+            base = s.slot_base(ring, slot)
+            rows = [
+                rt.Memory.lds(
+                    ring + 8 * DownWeights.word(base, half, lane_word, i), Uint64
+                )
+                for half in range(2)
+                for i in range(DownWeights.ROW_GROUPS)
+            ]
+            scales = []
+            for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(DownWeights.TILES):
+                    word = DownWeights.scale_word(bid, j, page, half, warp >> 2)
+                    scales.append(rt.Memory.lds(s.down_scales + 4 * word))
+            partial = [[None] * 12, [None] * 12]
+            for kh in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    group = 2 * page + half
+                    b = rt.Memory.lds_weak_b64(
+                        s.act
+                        + 4 * (Activations.GROUP_WORDS * group + act_word + 4 * kh)
+                    )
+                    acc = partial[half]
+                    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(DownWeights.TILES):
+                        quad, row = (
+                            slice(4 * j, 4 * j + 4),
+                            DownWeights.ROW_GROUPS * half + 2 * j,
+                        )
+                        acc[quad] = rt.Mma.step_u64(
+                            acc[quad], rows[row], rows[row + 1], kh, b, kh == 0
+                        )
+            pages.release(slot)
+            for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(DownWeights.TILES):
+                    quad, scale = (
+                        slice(4 * j, 4 * j + 4),
+                        scales[DownWeights.TILES * half + j],
+                    )
+                    total[quad] = rt.Mma.scale_accumulate(
+                        total[quad], partial[half][quad], scale
+                    )
+        return total
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def exchange(self, tid, warp, lane, bid, p, s, epoch, total, live=None):
+        v = rt.Memory.smem_views(s.base, self.layout.views())  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        words = v["local_o_words"]
+        self.SLICES.reduce_rows(
+            v["scratch"], v["local_o"], p.LocalO, total, tid, warp, lane, bid
+        )
+        self.SLICES.push_peers(p, words, epoch, bid, tid, warp, lane)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(live is None):
+            if warp == 0:
+                self.SLICES.combine(p, p.X, lane, bid, epoch, words)
+        else:
+            # The eight compute warps combine the groups of four rows in turn.
+            turns = -(-self.SLICES.groups // COMPUTE_WARPS)
+            for turn in cutlass.range_constexpr(turns):
+                group = warp + COMPUTE_WARPS * turn
+                if group * rt.SliceExchange.GROUP_TOKENS < live:
+                    self.SLICES.combine(
+                        p, p.X, lane, bid, epoch, words, False, group, live
+                    )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def compute_rows(self, tid, bid, warp, lane, views, p, s, pages):
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        live = views.RowTable[0]
+        if bid < UpWeights.CTAS:
+            self.normalize_row(tid, warp, lane, bid, p, s, live)
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_ALL)
+        epoch = rt.Memory.lds(s.epoch, Uint32)
+        first_down = Int32(0)
+        if bid < UpWeights.CTAS:
+            self.await_normalized(bid, warp, lane, p, epoch, live)
+            self.gate_up_rows(tid, warp, lane, bid, p, s, pages)
+            first_down = Int32(UpWeights.PAGES)
+        total = self.down_rows(warp, lane, bid, p, s, pages, first_down)
+        self.exchange(tid, warp, lane, bid, views, s, epoch, total, live)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def normalize_row(self, tid, warp, lane, bid, p, s, live):
+        if bid < live:
+            row = p.X + Int64(bid) * (2 * HIDDEN)
+            values = []
+            gamma = []
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(DenseFfnSmem.NORM_CHUNKS):
+                at = DenseFfnSmem.NORM_CHUNK_BYTES * j + tid * 16
+                values += rt.bf16x8_to_f32(rt.Memory.ld_cg_v4(row + Int64(at)))
+                gamma.append(rt.bf16x8_to_f32(rt.Memory.ldg_nc_v4(p.Gamma + Int64(at))))
+            square = rt.Reduce.warp_sum_down(rt.Reduce.sum_squares(values))
+            if lane == 0:
+                rt.Memory.sts(s.scratch + 4 * warp, square)
+            rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+            inverse = rt.Reduce.rms_inverse(
+                rt.Reduce.ordered_sum(
+                    lambda w: rt.Memory.lds(s.scratch + 4 * w), COMPUTE_WARPS
+                )
+            )
+            out = p.Activation + Int64(self.XN_OFFSET) + Int64(bid) * (2 * HIDDEN)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(DenseFfnSmem.NORM_CHUNKS):
+                chunk = DenseFfnSmem.NORM_VEC * j
+                rt.Memory.st_global_v4(
+                    out + Int64(DenseFfnSmem.NORM_CHUNK_BYTES * j + tid * 16),
+                    rt.Reduce.norm_bf16x8(
+                        values[chunk : chunk + DenseFfnSmem.NORM_VEC],
+                        inverse,
+                        gamma[j],
+                    ),
+                )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def await_normalized(self, bid, warp, lane, p, epoch, live):
+        with rt.warp_leader(warp, 0):
+            rt.Memory.fence_release_gpu()
+            rt.Memory.red_add_u32(p.Flags + Int64(XN_FLAGS + bid) * 4, 1)
+        if warp == 0:
+            ready = Int32(0)
+            while ready == 0:
+                satisfied = Int32(1)
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(UpWeights.CTAS // 32):
+                    if lane + 32 * k < live:
+                        observed = rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                            p.Flags + Int64(XN_FLAGS + lane + 32 * k) * 4
+                        )
+                        satisfied = satisfied & Int32(observed >= epoch + 1)
+                ready = Int32(rt.Sync.vote_all_asm(satisfied))
+            rt.Memory.fence_acquire_gpu()
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def issue_up_b(window, first, p, x_rows, chunks, warp, steps):
+        for step in range(first, min(first + steps, 8 * UpWeights.PAGES), 2):
+            page, k = divmod(step, 8)
+            e = (
+                16 * chunks[k // 4]
+                + 2 * (page * (UpWeights.PAGE_K // 2) + warp * (UpWeights.SLICE_K // 2))
+                + 4 * (k % 4)
+            )
+            loads = [rt.Memory.ld_cg_v4(x_row + Int64(e) * 2) for x_row in x_rows]
+            window[step] = [(w[0], w[1]) for w in loads]
+            window[step + 1] = [(w[2], w[3]) for w in loads]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def take_up_b(window, step, ahead, p, x_rows, chunks, warp):
+        if step % ahead == 0:
+            DenseFfn.issue_up_b(window, step + ahead, p, x_rows, chunks, warp, ahead)
+        return window.pop(step)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def gate_up_rows(self, tid, warp, lane, bid, p, s, pages):
+        rows, tiles = self.ROWS, self.ROWS // 8
+        ring = s.ring
+        accum = [Float32(0.0)] * (8 * tiles)
+        q = lane & 3
+        chunks = UpWeights.chunk_pair(q)
+        group = lane >> 2
+        xn = p.Activation + Int64(self.XN_OFFSET)
+        x_rows = [xn + Int64(8 * t + group) * (2 * HIDDEN) for t in range(tiles)]
+        # k-steps of B fragments in flight: L2 latency is hidden by loading ahead.
+        ahead = 2 * max(1, min(4, 12 // tiles))
+        window: dict = {}
+        self.issue_up_b(window, 0, p, x_rows, chunks, warp, ahead)
+        for page in cutlass.range_constexpr(UpWeights.PAGES):
+            slot = page % s.RING_SLOTS
+            pages.wait_full(page)
+            base = s.slot_base(ring, slot)
+            a_words = [None] * 32
+            for proj in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for hi in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        k = 16 * proj + 8 * hi + 4 * c
+                        a_words[k : k + 4] = rt.Memory.lds_b128(
+                            ring
+                            + UpWeights.chunk(base, warp, group, chunks[c])
+                            + 8 * SWIZZLE_ROW * hi
+                            + UpWeights.BOX_BYTES * proj
+                        )
+            slot_scales = ring + base + UpWeights.SLOT_SCALES
+            scales = [
+                rt.Memory.lds(slot_scales + UpWeights.SCALE_BYTES * proj + 4 * warp)
+                for proj in range(2)
+            ]
+
+            b_words = lambda k, page=page: self.take_up_b(  # noqa: E731
+                window, page * 8 + k, ahead, p, x_rows, chunks, warp
+            )
+            rt.Mma.gate_up_steps(accum, a_words, b_words, *scales, tiles=tiles)  # type: ignore[misc]
+            pages.release(slot)
+        stride = rows * 2 * UpWeights.ROWS + 1
+        store = s.scratch + 4 * (warp * stride + group)
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tiles):
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                token = 8 * t + 2 * q + i
+                for proj in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    for hi in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        rt.Memory.sts(
+                            store
+                            + 4 * (token * 2 * UpWeights.ROWS + proj * 16 + 8 * hi),
+                            accum[8 * t + 4 * proj + 2 * hi + i],
+                        )
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+        for rnd in cutlass.range_constexpr(-(-rows * 16 // COMPUTE_THREADS)):
+            index = tid + COMPUTE_THREADS * rnd
+            if cutlass.const_expr(rows * 16 % COMPUTE_THREADS == 0):  # noqa: SIM114  constexpr and runtime conditions stay separate
+                self.publish_activation(index, bid, p, s, stride)
+            elif index < rows * 16:
+                self.publish_activation(index, bid, p, s, stride)
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_COMPUTE)
+        with rt.warp_leader(warp, 0):
+            rt.Memory.fence_release_gpu()
+            rt.Memory.red_add_u32(p.Flags + Int64(bid) * 4, 1)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def publish_activation(self, index, bid, p, s, stride):
+        token, n = index >> UpWeights.ROW_SHIFT, index & (UpWeights.ROWS - 1)
+        gate, up = [
+            rt.Convert.bf16_to_f32(
+                rt.Convert.f32_to_bf16(
+                    rt.Reduce.ordered_sum(
+                        lambda w, proj=proj: rt.Memory.lds(
+                            s.scratch
+                            + 4
+                            * (w * stride + token * 2 * UpWeights.ROWS + proj * 16 + n)
+                        ),
+                        COMPUTE_WARPS,
+                    )
+                )
+            )
+            for proj in (0, 1)
+        ]
+        e = cute.math.exp2(rt.mul(gate, NEG_LOG2E), fastmath=True)
+        rcp = rt.FastMath.rcp_rn(rt.add(1.0, e))
+        col = Activations.col((bid & (Activations.GROUP_CTAS - 1)) * UpWeights.ROWS + n)
+        element = Activations.index(
+            bid >> Activations.GROUP_SHIFT, token, col, self.ROWS
+        )
+        rt.Memory.stg_b16(
+            p.Activation + Int64(element) * 2,
+            rt.Convert.f32_to_bf16(rt.mul(rt.mul(gate, rcp), up)),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def issue_down_b(window, item, p, rows, lane, warp, tiles):
+        if item >= DownWeights.PAGES * tiles:
+            return
+        page, tile = divmod(item, tiles)
+        column = (
+            (warp >> 2) * 64
+            + ((warp >> 1) & 1) * 32
+            + ((lane >> 1) & 1) * 16
+            + (warp & 1) * 8
+            + (lane & 1) * 2
+        )
+        pairs = {}
+        for kh in range(2):
+            for half in range(2):
+                element = (
+                    ((2 * page + half) * rows + 8 * tile + (lane >> 2))
+                    * Activations.GROUP_COLS
+                    + 2 * column
+                    + 8 * kh
+                )
+                pairs[(kh, half)] = rt.Memory.ld_cg_v2(
+                    p.Activation + Int64(element) * 2
+                )
+        window[item] = pairs
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def down_rows(self, warp, lane, bid, p, s, pages, first_down):
+        rows, tiles = self.ROWS, self.ROWS // 8
+        ring = s.ring
+        total = [Float32(0.0)] * (4 * DownWeights.TILES * tiles)
+        lane_word = DownWeights.lane_word(warp, lane)
+        window: dict = {}
+        rt.bar_sync(*BAR_ALL)
+        # Items of B fragments in flight (one item: four 8-byte loads per lane).
+        ahead = max(1, min(4, 12 // tiles))
+        for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(ahead):
+            self.issue_down_b(window, item, p, rows, lane, warp, tiles)
+        for page in cutlass.range_constexpr(DownWeights.PAGES):
+            sequence = first_down + page
+            slot = pages.slot(sequence)
+            pages.wait_full(sequence, slot)
+            base = s.slot_base(ring, slot)
+            weights = [
+                rt.Memory.lds(
+                    ring + 8 * DownWeights.word(base, half, lane_word, i), Uint64
+                )
+                for half in range(2)
+                for i in range(DownWeights.ROW_GROUPS)
+            ]

+class DownPlane:
+    """Down records in the ring: 48 rows x 256 K E4M3 per expert, 1 KiB-aligned, then
+    scales.

+
+    BOX = 6144
+    RECORD = 2 * BOX
+    TX = RECORD + 32
+    SCALES = 2 * RECORD

+    def pad(base, off):

+
+    @staticmethod
+    def lane_word(warp, lane):
+        group = cdiv(lane, 4)
+        chunk = cmod(warp, 4) + 4 * (cmod(cdiv(lane, 2), 2)) ^ group
+        return cdiv(cdiv(warp, 4) * DownPlane.BOX + group * 128 + chunk * 16, 8) + cmod(
+            lane, 2
+        )

+    @staticmethod
+    def rows(ring_u64, byte_base, warp, lane) -> list:
+        first = (byte_base >> 3) + DownPlane.lane_word(warp, lane)
+        return [ring_u64[first + 128 * r] for r in range(6)]

+    @staticmethod
+    def k_words(warp, lane):

+            cdiv(warp, 4) * 64

+            + cmod(cdiv(lane, 2), 2) * 16
+            + cmod(warp, 2) * 8
+            + cmod(lane, 2) * 2
+        )

+        return (
+            block
+            + (
+                cdiv(bid * COLUMNS + 16 * k, 128)

+            )
+            * 2
+            + cdiv(warp, 4)
+        )

+    @staticmethod

+        for j in range(3):

+                total[j * 4 + 2 * q + 1] = rt.fma(

+    @cute.jit
+    def rms_norm(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, gammas):
+        rows = self.ROWS
+        tid, warp, lane = s.tid, s.warp, s.lane
+        values = cute.make_rmem_tensor(24 * rows, Float32)
+        squares = cute.make_rmem_tensor(rows, Float32)
+        for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(rows):
+            squares[token] = Float32(0.0)
+            for part in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                row_word = cdiv(token * NORM_ROW + part * 2048 + tid * 8, 2)
+                words_f32 = rt.Convert.ld_bf16x8_words(s.norm_words, row_word)
+                for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    values[token * 24 + part * 8 + item] = words_f32[item]
+                    squares[token] = rt.fma(
+                        words_f32[item], words_f32[item], squares[token]
+                    )
+        last = rt.Reduce.fold([squares[t] for t in range(4)], lane, 16, (4, 2, 1))
+        if (lane & 7) == 0:
+            s.scratch[((lane >> 3) & 3) * 8 + warp] = last
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        inverses = Rms.inverses(s.scratch, rows)
+        for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(rows):
+            for part in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                row_value = token * 24 + part * 8
+                norm_dst = s.norm_addr + (token * NORM_ROW + part * 2048 + tid * 8) * 2
+                row_values = [values[row_value + i] for i in range(8)]
+                Rms.store(norm_dst, row_values, inverses[token], gammas[part])
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)

+    @cute.jit
+    def score_and_route(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, early_bias):
+        tid = s.tid
+        denominators = cute.make_rmem_tensor(self.ROWS, Float32)
+        for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.ROWS):
+            denominators[token] = rt.add(
+                1.0,
+                cute.math.exp2(
+                    rt.mul(-s.logits[token * 256 + tid], LOG2E), fastmath=True
+                ),
+            )
+        s.first_lane[tid] = 32
+        for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.ROWS):
+            score = rt.FastMath.rcp_rn(denominators[token])
+            s.scores[token * 256 + tid] = score
+            self.store_finite(s.corrected, token * 256 + tid, rt.add(score, early_bias))
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        if s.warp < self.ROWS:
+            routes = (
+                s.corrected,
+                s.scores,
+                s.route_ids,
+                s.route_weights,
+                p.RouteIds,
+                p.RouteWeights,
+            )
+            self.route_token(
+                routes, s.warp * 256, s.lane, s.warp, s.bid, s.route_full, s.warp
+            )
+        if tid < 128:
+            s.union_route[tid] = 0.0
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)

+        round_index,

+    @cute.jit
+    def publish_slice(
+        self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, accum, round_index, shared: cutlass.Constexpr
+    ):
+        tid = s.tid
+        self.store_partials(s, accum, s.warp, s.lane)
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)
+        if tid < 16 * self.ROWS:
+            token, row = cdiv(tid, 16), cmod(tid, 16)
+            act = self.silu_up(s.scratch, token, row)
+            p.Activation[self.activation_index(s, token, row, round_index, shared)] = (
+                act.to(BFloat16)
+            )
+        rt.bar_sync(8, 256)

+    def activation_index(self, s: MoeState, token, row, round_index, shared: bool):
+        if shared:
+            return token * 256 + ActPlane.col((s.bid - ROUTED_CTAS) * 16 + row)
+        plane = 1 + cdiv(s.bid, 16) + 8 * round_index
+        return (plane * self.ROWS + token) * 256 + ActPlane.col(
+            cmod(s.bid, 16) * 16 + row
+        )

+    @cute.jit
+    def store_partials(self, s: MoeState, accum, warp, lane):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.ROWS == 8):
+            base = warp * self.PARTIAL_STRIDE + cmod(lane, 4) * 64 + cdiv(lane, 4)
+            for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for column in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                    s.scratch[base + column * 32 + m * 16] = accum[m * 4 + column]
+                    s.scratch[base + column * 32 + m * 16 + 8] = accum[
+                        m * 4 + column + 2
+                    ]
+        else:
+            self.stage_partials(
+                s.scratch,
+                accum,
+                warp * self.PARTIAL_STRIDE + cmod(lane, 4) * 32 + cdiv(lane, 4),
+            )
+
+    def silu_up(self, scratch, token, row):
+        stride = self.PARTIAL_STRIDE
+        gate = scratch[token * 32 + row]
+        up = scratch[token * 32 + 16 + row]
+        for w in range(1, 8):
+            gate = rt.add(gate, scratch[w * stride + token * 32 + row])
+            up = rt.add(up, scratch[w * stride + token * 32 + 16 + row])
+        return rt.mul(
+            rt.mul(
+                gate,
+                rt.FastMath.rcp_rn(
+                    rt.add(1.0, cute.math.exp2(rt.mul(-gate, LOG2E), fastmath=True))
+                ),
+            ),
+            up,
+        )
+
+    def stage_partials(self, scratch, accum, base):
+        for m in range(2):
+            scratch[base + m * 16] = accum[m * 4]
+            scratch[base + m * 16 + 8] = accum[m * 4 + 2]

+    @cute.jit
+    def gate_up_page(self, s: MoeState, accum, sequence, k_words, warp, lane):
+        slot_bytes = self.SLOT_BYTES
+        slot = cmod(sequence, self.RING_SLOTS)
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.ring_full + slot * 8, cmod(cdiv(sequence, self.RING_SLOTS), 2))
+        up_rows = cute.make_rmem_tensor(32, Uint32)
+        odd = cmod(cdiv(lane, 4), 2)
+        chunk = cdiv(
+            slot * slot_bytes + cdiv(lane, 4) * 1024 + warp * 128 + cmod(lane, 4) * 16,
+            4,
+        )
+        for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            r0 = rt.Memory.lds_b128(
+                s.ring_words_addr + (chunk + 2048 * h + 16 * odd) * 4
+            )
+            r1 = rt.Memory.lds_b128(
+                s.ring_words_addr + (chunk + 2048 * h + 16 - 16 * odd) * 4
+            )
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                up_rows[8 * h + i] = Uint32(cutlass.select_(odd != 0, r1[i], r0[i]))
+                up_rows[8 * h + 4 + i] = Uint32(cutlass.select_(odd != 0, r0[i], r1[i]))
+        scale_base = slot * (slot_bytes // 4) + 8192
+        gate_scale = s.ring_f32[scale_base + warp]
+        up_scale = s.ring_f32[scale_base + 8 + warp]
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.EARLY_RELEASE):
+            s.pages.release(slot)
+        norm = s.norm_words_addr
+        b_words = lambda k: rt.Memory.lds_weak_b64(
+            norm + (k_words + k % 4 * 2 + k // 4 * 32) * 4
+        )
+        rt.Mma.gate_up_steps(accum, up_rows, b_words, gate_scale, up_scale)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not self.EARLY_RELEASE):
+            s.pages.release(slot)

+    def routed_down(self, s: MoeState, total, count, first_down):

+    @cute.jit
+    def routed_down_record_pair(
+        self, s: MoeState, total, count, first_down, page, route_lane
+    ):
+        bid, lane, warp = s.bid, s.lane, s.warp
+        sequence_dn = first_down + page
+        slot_dn = cmod(sequence_dn, 4)
+        rt.mbar_wait(s.ring_full + slot_dn * 8, cmod(cdiv(sequence_dn, 4), 2))
+        er_second = cutlass.min(page * 2 + 1, count - 1)
+        er_scales = cute.make_rmem_tensor(6, Float32)
+        page_rows = []
+        rb = slot_dn * self.SLOT_BYTES + DownPlane.pad(
+            s.ring_u64_addr, slot_dn * self.SLOT_BYTES
+        )
+        for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            page_rows += DownPlane.rows(
+                s.ring_u64, rb + DownPlane.RECORD * h, warp, lane
+            )
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                er_scales[3 * h + j] = s.ring_f32[
+                    DownPlane.scale_word(
+                        rb + DownPlane.SCALES + 32 * h >> 2, bid, warp, j
+                    )
+                ]
+        self.admit_down_page(s, page)
+        lane_words = self.down_lane_words(warp, lane)
+        er_part = (rt.zeros((4, 3)), rt.zeros((4, 3)))
+        expert_row = (page * 2, er_second)
+        for kk_dn in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                b_0 = rt.Memory.lds_weak_b64(
+                    s.act_words_addr
+                    + (self.down_plane_word(expert_row[h]) + lane_words + 4 * kk_dn) * 4
+                )
+                for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                    acc_tile = er_part[h][None, m]
+                    row_a, row_b = (
+                        page_rows[6 * h + 2 * m],
+                        page_rows[6 * h + 2 * m + 1],
+                    )
+                    frag = rt.Convert.a_frag_u64(row_a, row_b, kk_dn)
+                    rt.TensorCore.mma_acc(acc_tile, frag, b_0, False)
+        s.pages.release(slot_dn)
+        DownPlane.accum(
+            total, er_part[0], er_scales, 0, *self.route_pair(s, page * 2, route_lane)
+        )
+        if count > page * 2 + 1:
+            DownPlane.accum(
+                total,
+                er_part[1],
+                er_scales,
+                3,
+                *self.route_pair(s, er_second, route_lane),
+            )

+    @cute.jit
+    def publish_logit(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, logit, epoch):
+        tid, bid, Flags = s.tid, s.bid, p.Flags
+        p.RouterLogits[cdiv(tid, 2) * 256 + bid * 2 + cmod(tid, 2)] = logit
+        bits = logit.bitcast(Uint32)
+        if bits == Uint32(2147483648):
+            bits = Uint32(0)
+        word = cdiv(tid, 2) * 256 + bid * 2 + cmod(tid, 2)
+        parity = Int32(cmod(epoch, 2))
+        filled = self.Flag.PAD_FIRST + (1 + parity) * self.Flag.PAGE + word
+        rt.Memory.st_relaxed_sys(rt.ga(Flags, filled), bits ^ Uint32(2147483648))
+        rt.Memory.st_relaxed_sys(
+            rt.ga(Flags, filled + self.Flag.MIRROR), bits ^ Uint32(2147483648)
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def clear_stale_logits(self, Flags, epoch, bid, i, copy: cutlass.Constexpr):
+        word = cdiv(i, 2) * 256 + bid * 2 + cmod(i, 2)
+        parity = Int32(cmod(epoch, 2))
+        rt.Memory.st_relaxed_sys(
+            rt.ga(
+                Flags,
+                self.Flag.PAD_FIRST
+                + (2 - parity) * self.Flag.PAGE
+                + copy * self.Flag.MIRROR
+                + word,
+            ),
+            0,
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def count_router_slice(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState):
+        Flags, bid = p.Flags, s.bid
+        base = self.Flag.PAD_FIRST + bid
+        cute.arch.atomic_add(Flags.iterator + base, Uint32(1))
+        cute.arch.atomic_add(Flags.iterator + (base + self.Flag.MIRROR), Uint32(1))
+        cute.arch.atomic_add(Flags.iterator + bid, Uint32(1))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def pull_logits(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, epoch_ld, lane_0):
+        Flags = p.Flags
+        near = Int32(
+            rt.Memory.ld_relaxed_gpu(
+                rt.ga(Flags, self.Flag.SM_DOMAIN + Int32(rt.Sync.smid()))
+            )
+        )
+        polled = self.Flag.PAD_FIRST + near * self.Flag.MIRROR
+        slot_owned = Int32(lane_0 < 128)
+        slot_index = polled + cutlass.min(lane_0, 127)
+        self.poll_all(Flags, slot_owned, slot_index, epoch_ld)
+        rt.bar_sync(9, 128)
+        tagged_base = (
+            self.Flag.PAD_FIRST
+            + (1 + Int32(cmod(epoch_ld, 2))) * self.Flag.PAGE
+            + (1 - near) * self.Flag.MIRROR
+        )
+        self.poll_logit_words(Flags, s, tagged_base, lane_0, self.ROWS // 2)
+        return polled
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def poll_logit_words(
+        self, Flags, s: MoeState, tagged_base, lane_0, halves: cutlass.Constexpr
+    ):
+        kept = cute.make_rmem_tensor(4 * halves, Uint32)
+        done = Int32(0)
+        while done == 0:
+            present = Int32(1)
+            for h_ld in cutlass.range_constexpr(halves):
+                w = rt.Memory.ld_volatile_v4(
+                    rt.ga(Flags, tagged_base + (lane_0 + 128 * h_ld) * 4)
+                )
+                for item_ld in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    kept[4 * h_ld + item_ld] = w[item_ld]
+                    present = present & Int32(w[item_ld] != 0)
+            done = Int32(cute.arch.vote_all_sync(present != 0))
+        for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(halves):
+            for item_ld in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                s.logits_words[lane_0 * 4 + item_ld + 512 * half] = kept[
+                    4 * half + item_ld
+                ] ^ Uint32(2147483648)

+    @cute.jit
+    def up_page(
+        self,
+        p: MoeParams,
+        s: MoeState,
+        sequence,
+        page,
+        expert,
+        row16,
+        shared: cutlass.Constexpr = False,
+    ):
+        slot_bytes = self.SLOT_BYTES
+        slot = cmod(sequence, self.RING_SLOTS)
+        with rt.warp_leader(s.warp, 8):
+            s.pages.acquire(sequence, UpPage.TX, slot)
+            scales = p.SharedScales if shared else p.RoutedUpScales
+            first = 0 if shared else Int64(expert) * LAYOUT.w13_scale_words
+            block = cdiv(row16, 8) * 48 + page * 8
+            for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                box_dst = s.ring_addr + slot * slot_bytes + UpPage.BOX * h
+                full = s.ring_full + slot * 8
+                half = h if shared else 1 - h
+                if cutlass.const_expr(shared):
+                    rt.AsyncCopy.tma_4d(
+                        box_dst,
+                        self.shared_up_map,
+                        0,
+                        page * 4,
+                        256 * h + row16 * 16,
+                        0,
+                        full,
+                        _HINT,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    rt.AsyncCopy.tma_4d(
+                        box_dst,
+                        self.up_map,
+                        0,
+                        expert * 48 + page * 8,
+                        32 * half + row16 * 2,
+                        0,
+                        full,
+                        _HINT,
+                    )
+                scale_dst = s.ring_addr + slot * slot_bytes + UpPage.SCALES + 32 * h
+                scale_src = rt.ga(scales, first + block + 96 * half)
+                rt.bulk_g2s(scale_dst, scale_src, 32, s.ring_full + slot * 8)

+    @cute.jit
+    def routed_down_page(self, p: MoeParams, s: MoeState, sequence, page, count, ids):
+        slot_bytes = self.SLOT_BYTES
+        slot = cmod(sequence, self.RING_SLOTS)
+        with rt.warp_leader(s.warp, 8):
+            rt.mbar_wait(
+                s.ring_empty + slot * 8, cmod(cdiv(sequence, self.RING_SLOTS), 2) ^ 1
+            )
+            records = cutlass.min(count - page * 2, 2)
+            rt.mbar_expect_tx(s.ring_full + slot * 8, records * DownPlane.TX)
+            aligned = s.ring_addr + (
+                slot * slot_bytes + DownPlane.pad(s.ring_addr, slot * slot_bytes)
+            )
+            for within in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                if records > within:
+                    record = ids[page * 2 + within]
+                    for h in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                        box_dst = (
+                            aligned + within * DownPlane.RECORD + DownPlane.BOX * h
+                        )
+                        groups = (2 * record + h) * (rt.HIDDEN // 16) + s.bid * 3
+                        full = s.ring_full + slot * 8
+                        rt.AsyncCopy.tma_4d(
+                            box_dst, self.down_map, 0, 0, 0, groups, full, _HINT
+                        )
+                    scale_dst = aligned + DownPlane.SCALES + within * 32
+                    scale_src = rt.ga(
+                        p.RoutedDownScales,
+                        record * LAYOUT.w2_scale_words + DownPlane.scales(s.bid),
+                    )
+                    rt.bulk_g2s(scale_dst, scale_src, 32, s.ring_full + slot * 8)

+class MoeQ4Smem(rt.SmemLayout):
+    """Shared memory of q4 and the seam."""
+
+    ROWS = 4
+    MAX_UNION = ROWS * TOP_K
+    ROUNDS = 4
+    PLANES = 1 + MAX_UNION
+    SLOT_BYTES = 32896
+    SHARED_DOWN = RING_SLOTS * SLOT_BYTES
+    SHARED_DOWN_SPAN = 1024 + DownPlane.RECORD
+    SMEM_BYTES = 228608

+    a = rt.SmemAlloc(SMEM_BYTES)
+    ring_full = a.mbarriers(RING_SLOTS, arrivals=1)

+    shared_down_full = a.mbarriers(1, arrivals=1)

+    rows_free = a.mbarriers(1, arrivals=1)
+    round_done = a.mbarriers(ROUNDS, arrivals=COMPUTE_THREADS)
+    with a.union(align=1024):
